source5 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_19/test_5.csv", index_col=0)  # ['Artist', 'Albums in RS500']
source6 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_19/test_6.csv", index_col=0)  # ['Artist', 'Year Inducted', 'Years Waited', '# of Years Nominated', 'Inducted By']
source7 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_19/test_7.csv", index_col=0)  # ['Artist', 'Top 100 Singles', 'Highest Position']
source8 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_19/test_8.csv", index_col=0)  # ['Artist', 'Times on Cover of RS']

source1_extended = source1.copy()
source1_extended['Inducted By'] = pd.NA

# Reorder columns to match source6
source1_extended = source1_extended[source6.columns]

# Union source1_extended and source6
dim_inducted = pd.concat([source1_extended, source6], ignore_index=True)

# Step 2: Join all other aspect tables one by one with dim_inducted on 'Artist'
# Use left joins to preserve all artists from the dimension table

df = pd.merge(dim_inducted, source0, on='Artist', how='left')  # Certified Units (Millions)
df = pd.merge(df, source4, on='Artist', how='left')            # Influenced
df = pd.merge(df, source5, on='Artist', how='left')            # Albums in RS500
df = pd.merge(df, source7, on='Artist', how='left')            # Top 100 Singles, Highest Position
df = pd.merge(df, source8, on='Artist', how='left')            # Times on Cover of RS
df = pd.merge(df, source3, on='Artist', how='left')            # Score
df = pd.merge(df, source2, on='Artist', how='left')            # Spotify

    'Year Inducted': 'mean',  # float, average
    'Years Waited': 'max',    # integer, max waited years
    '# of Years Nominated': 'max',  # integer, max nominations
    'Inducted By': lambda x: x.dropna().iloc[0] if not x.dropna().empty else pd.NA,  # first non-null string
    'Influenced': 'max',      # integer, max influenced count
    'Certified Units (Millions)': 'max',  # float, max certified units
    'Albums in RS500': 'max',  # integer, max albums count
    'Top 100 Singles': 'max',  # integer, max singles count
    'Highest Position': 'min',  # integer, min position (best rank)
    'Times on Cover of RS': 'max',  # integer, max times on cover
    'Score': 'mean',          # float, average score
    'Spotify': 'max'          # integer, max spotify count

    '# of Years Nominated',
    'Inducted By',
    'Influenced',
    'Certified Units (Millions)',
    'Albums in RS500',
    'Top 100 Singles',
    'Highest Position',
    'Times on Cover of RS',
    'Score',
    'Spotify'
]
